limitations: Policy read from .qorlogic/config.json at repo root only; no env var, no global-scope merge, no per-commit override.
The policy never suppresses the 'Authored via [Qor-logic SDLC]' line.
non_goals: No rewriting of published history to add or remove trailers on existing commits.
No change to pr_footer or changelog_attribution_line.
No change to the emoji carve-out.
exclusions: Operator instruction files are out of scope; this changes what Qor-logic requires.

ci_commands: python -m ruff check qor/scripts/attribution_policy.py qor/scripts/attribution.py qor/scripts/seal_trailer_check.py
